items.why: The snippet inserts a free account on verify, which contradicts deferring creation until browser approval
Missing auth is rejected with an API-key requirement, so this path is not unauthenticated device-code onboarding
The update only sets device status to revoked and does not invalidate an API key
An initialize-plus-api_key guard is unrelated to revocation or key invalidation
The listing includes other group devices and NULL device_id rows, so content is not private per device
The handler loads an item by id with no identity or device parameter
Admission is computed from COUNT of already-created items rather than a reservation
Launching Puppeteer does not show reservations or completed-item counting
A per-email magic-link send cap does not establish that email verification is an insufficient farming defense
The page publishes that limits will not change without notice
A 250 MiB per-item constant is not a published entitlement or a capture-specific-limit reconciliation
Returning when no expired rows exist does not show TTL configuration or required cleanup changes
